name: Idyllic Dream: Cozy Clone Edition "Safe Defams, Sweet Dreams ♡"

attr.text:
Then count CLOCKWISE
from NORTH or SOUTH to
get your number

This is basically just DN Idyllic Dream
with a small adjustment for
simplicity and uptime in one
particular part

8 Tether boys will arrive.
Grab what you need from
your quadrant.

Check your clone's position
to see what type of
tether to grab

1) Whatever mechanic is at
CARDINALS will be triggering first

2) Stacks & Defams will always alternate

3) Your acting order as a party will be:

                   ->          ->           ->

All 4 cardinals will have one tether type.
All 4 intercards will have the other.

The tethers grabbed from
North & South during this step
will be the first to trigger,
and the order will continue
clockwise from there.

Note the safespots you see
here, and note which side
HOURGLASS is on

BOWTIE will always
be opposite HOURGLASS

CIRCLE will always
be closest to mid

While you get ready for
that, you will be visited
by three Boys

Right after that, the boss
is going to cut the arena
down to 2 circular platforms

On each platform,
4 towers will appear, with
4 flavours of meteor
descending upon them

EARTH METEOR:
Get out after hit
(rock AOE will happen
after a few seconds)

NEAPOLITAN WIND:
Will launch you
(aim at opposite platform)

FIRE METEOR:
Stand still after hit,
until debuff clears

The meteors won't hit during this step
of the mechanic! Right now, you're just
getting information and confirming if
anyone needs to make swaps.

If you get this debuff, you CANNOT
take a Neapolitan tower.
(Again, the towers aren't happening yet. We're just confirming how we will take them later)

Swap vertically if you need to,
and accomodate your partner
if they need to swap.

The boss will hit 4 players
with a cast that gives a vuln debuff.
The Boys are Back In Town
HOURGLASS makes the boss side safe!

A visitor from the other mechanic
emerges from the portal!

NEAPOLITAN DARK:
Will shoot a line AOE
(aim it outward away 
from people)

Back to the towers again

Take the tower you
established earlier

One will jump in a portal.
In this example it's BOWTIE

We like it when that happens.
but sometimes HOURGLASS
leaves instead.

The other two will
jump to platforms
We return once again to the full arena
Now our clones start to pop

We love it when BOWTIE
goes last, he makes the boss
side safe for us again

(As usual, this isn't happening right now,
we'll just have to remember it in a moment)

HOURGLASS or BOWTIE
can be dodged on the platform they pick.

CIRCLE makes his
whole platform unsafe!

You may find it easier to learn each mechanic separately
before combining the full sequence, depends how ur brain works.
Slides are colour coded if that helps

Both these stack players are just
going in front of their own clones
Get back to the safe platform!
The Boys will fire their AOEs

A moment after those tethers
lock, these AOEs will happen for real

All players will bait at the cardinal
NEAREST THEIR OWN CLONE

Refer back to your
ORIGINAL CLONE
POSITIONS

Back to the green arena, and now
our tethers will begin to trigger.

...and then set up like this
(True North positions)
once the coast is clear

Earth & Fire spots are
interchangeable,
just take them by role
Cardinals or intercards can be first (remember from the VERY start)

These will trigger 4 at a time
(2 stacks and 2 defams,
at fixed clock spots every time,
thanks to the way
we set everything up)

Each Boy knows 1 AOE,
and he will show it to you.

No need to dodge!
It's not real yet

While defams are popping,
everyone else should stand max-melee
Northeast, for SAFETY & UPTIME

These tiny downtime safespots?
Forget 'em! Don't need 'em!

there was never a
reason to do this!

*These players have clones on intercards, but they're
still popping at the cardinals to keep things nice and static.

Both these defam players are just
going behind their own clones
Stack BEHIND your stack-clone for safety!

The defam & stack layout is similar to before,
BUT: Defams are not at the edge like they were when us
Real Players were baiting them! The safe spot is smaller!

We do 4-2 stacks
because hey why not

Dooms will shoot Near cones
Winds will shoot Far cones

The Melees with Earth or Fire are each trying to
be the CLOSEST bait to their Doom

The Ranged players with Earth or Fire are each trying to
be the FURTHEST bait from the OTHER platform's Wind

Based on your number,
preposition* in pairs in new
quadrants

If you're in the right places,
each quadrant will have one player
who wants a stack, and one player
who wants a defamation

*We have a ton of time and not much
is happening yet. Feel free to get your
positionals, Melees! Just keep your
quadrant in mind.

We'll say it's Cardinals first
in this example.

These will appear in sets of 4.

Either cardinals or Intercards can
appear first, which will become
important at the very end!

The set that appears first here
will also trigger first much later on.

OUR GOAL:
We want the 4 cardinal
player clones to end up with
2 stacks and 2 defamations.
We want the same for the
intercards.

This will make the pattern
resolvable later, when those
sets of 4 start to trigger.

The boss will not just hand us a
pattern like that, so we'll use a
system to assign what each
player grabs.

So we won't
die when 4 clones
pop at once!

Why this works: Matching our own clones keeps
the resolution the same as the re-enactment later (slide 21 onward)

Defams join the nearest
stack when not popping

CLONE IS AT CARDINAL:
CLONE IS AT INTERCARD:
GOT TETHER FROM CARDINAL:
GOT TETHER FROM INTERCARD:

You're in the 1st set
You're in the 2nd set
Your mech is 1st
Your mech is 2nd

(AND WHENEVER DEFAMS POP,
EVERYONE ELSE DODGES NORTHEAST)

Bait your own mech at the nearest cardinal
(if at intercard, adjust CCW)

See Slide #11 for the tl;dr
on changes from DN
